title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?

tldr.en: Use image-editing denoising KV context for an action flow expert instead of dense future video; target RGB need not be decoded.
tldr.zh: 以图像编辑去噪的 KV 上下文驱动动作 Flow 专家，替代稠密未来视频，推理无需解码目标 RGB。

evaluation_scope.en: Simulation and real-robot comparisons; distinguish retaining latent visual computation from decoding future RGB. Detailed timing configuration not extracted here.
evaluation_scope.zh: 仿真与真机对比；应区分保留潜在视觉计算与解码未来 RGB。本次未摘录详细计时配置。
